package.name: il_dataset
package.description: Imitation-Learning Dataset Collection — two-level hierarchical local expert (joint_v2 production path): a 5 Hz C++ VisibilityTargetCorrector (PASS_THROUGH / NORMAL_CORRECTION / TURN_LEFT / TURN_RIGHT) + a 30 Hz C++ LocalPlanner30Hz, unified by a single C++ HierarchicalExpertFsm and an EffectiveTargetAdapter (body-FLU unit direction + normalized distance information bottleneck). C++17 owns all expert / map / search / label logic (library il_hierarchical_expert_lib, pybind module _il_hierarchical_expert); Python (il_manager.py) owns the ROS/Flightmare lifecycle, depth/state sync, expert invocation and dataset writing. Collects via AvoidBench Unity / Flightmare (schema v25 + 5 Hz extension two_level_expert_labels_v1). The legacy CausalLocalTargetStream / PrivilegedMicroDetourPlanner / Python MacroExpert chain was REMOVED entirely (deleted sources, tests and old expert targets; the C++ build never builds them, even under CATKIN_ENABLE_TESTING).
